text: Ordinary hours wages and salary count towards qualifying earnings, including daily rates and flexi-time arrangements.
Casual loading counts towards qualifying earnings.
Shift penalties, including public holiday penalties, count towards qualifying earnings when they are paid for ordinary hours.
Overtime does not count towards qualifying earnings where ordinary hours are clearly set by an award or agreement.
Annual leave loading linked to lost overtime does not count towards qualifying earnings.

All commissions count towards qualifying earnings, including commissions paid solely for work done entirely outside ordinary hours. This is a change from ordinary time earnings, where such commissions did not count.

Bonuses for ordinary hours work count towards qualifying earnings, including performance, Christmas, sign-on and referral bonuses. Bonuses paid solely for work done entirely outside ordinary hours do not count.
Task, skill, higher duties, leading hand, first aid and supervisor allowances count towards qualifying earnings.
Allowances for adverse working conditions, such as heat, heights or confined spaces, count towards qualifying earnings.
An expense allowance paid regardless of whether the expense is actually incurred counts towards qualifying earnings.
An expense allowance that is expected to be fully spent, for example a tool allowance fully used for tools, does not count towards qualifying earnings.
On-call allowances paid for availability outside ordinary hours, and call-back allowances, do not count towards qualifying earnings.

reference: Table 6, row 1 (Cash out of leave in service)
text: Cash-out of a rostered day off (RDO) accrued from ordinary hours worked, taken while still employed, counts towards qualifying earnings.

reference: Table 6, row 2 (Cash out of leave in service)
text: Cash-out of time off in lieu (TOIL) does not count towards qualifying earnings.
An unused rostered day off (RDO) paid out on termination does not count towards qualifying earnings, unlike a cash-out of the same RDO taken in service.
Payment in lieu of notice counts towards qualifying earnings.
Unused annual leave or long service leave paid on termination does not count towards qualifying earnings, including on genuine redundancy.
Parental leave pay, whether employer funded or government funded, does not count towards qualifying earnings.
Workers compensation payments count towards qualifying earnings for hours actually worked, or where the employee is required to attend work.
Workers compensation payments do not count towards qualifying earnings when the employee is not required to work.
Directors' fees count towards qualifying earnings.
Salary sacrifice amounts count towards qualifying earnings where the underlying payment would itself have counted.
Paid annual leave, sick leave and long service leave count towards qualifying earnings, except under portable long service leave schemes.
Jury duty, defence reserve and community service leave do not count towards qualifying earnings.

source: Hospitality Industry (General) Award MA000009 (illustrative clause numbers, not yet verified against the real award text)
text: Ordinary hours of work under this award are an average of 38 hours per week, worked across a roster that may include weekends and public holidays.

source: Hospitality Industry (General) Award MA000009 (illustrative clause numbers, not yet verified against the real award text)
text: An employee required to work in adverse conditions, such as extreme heat or confined spaces, is paid an allowance for the period the conditions apply. This allowance compensates for the conditions themselves, not for an expense incurred by the employee.

source: Hospitality Industry (General) Award MA000009 (illustrative clause numbers, not yet verified against the real award text)
text: An expense-related allowance reimburses an employee for a specific outlay they incur in the course of their employment, such as a tool or uniform allowance, and is distinct from an allowance paid to compensate for working conditions.

source: Hospitality Industry (General) Award MA000009 (illustrative clause numbers, not yet verified against the real award text)
text: Overtime is payable for all time worked outside the ordinary hours set out in clause 13, or in excess of the rostered maximum for a shift.
